$comment: The compatibility record for the Munarium client libraries. Generated and maintained by hand at release time. Update this file, never the historical notes in README.md, which are a dated changelog of what was true when they were written.
policy: Each Clients minor release supports the current Server minor and the one before it (N and N-1). A breaking MMP wire change bumps mmp_contract_major; Server serves both majors for one Server minor release so Clients can move without a flag day. Clients version independently of Server: a shared version number on a given release is a coincidence of that release, not a rule.
note: Server clients target Server 1.1.1 and retain the 1.0 minor baseline. Client package versions remain 1.0.0: Server 1.1 adds Ollama through existing wire fields, and 1.1.1 fixes server-side session model routing without changing MMP major 1. Ollama requires Server 1.1; applying a session override to query expansion as well as completion requires 1.1.1. Entries carrying speaks_to: matrix remain independently compatible with Matrix 1.0 and are unchanged by this Server alignment. The Rust client path-depends on munarium-api-types and munarium-proto, which are server crates: both must reach crates.io before munarium-client can be published there.
